title: Tooltip
description: A short text label shown when the user hovers over or focuses an element. Near the viewport edges it flips and shifts to stay visible.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Wrap a focusable element. The tooltip shows on hover and on keyboard focus, and Escape closes it, even when it was opened by hover.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: color picks the semantic color: neutral (default), info, success, warning or danger.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: variant picks the style: solid (default; filled, the neutral one is an inverted surface that contrasts with the theme), subtle (tinted surface with a border) or glass (frosted surface that follows the theme; the color tints its border).

shapes.title: Shapes
shapes.description: Default, rounded, square and thought-bubble shapes.

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: Choose how the tooltip enters and leaves.

custom-colors.title: Custom colors, arrow and offset
custom-colors.description: Set the --tooltip-bg (solid colors and CSS gradients) and --tooltip-color custom properties on the tooltip through contentClassName; arrow adds a pointer to the trigger; offset sets the gap to the trigger (8px by default).

delays.title: Delays and disabled
delays.description: enterDelay and leaveDelay control the hover timing; disabled turns the tooltip off.

follow-cursor.title: Follow cursor
follow-cursor.description: With followCursor the tooltip tracks the mouse pointer.

controlled.title: Controlled and imperative
controlled.description: Control visibility with open and onOpenChange (hover, focus and Escape still request changes), or call open / close / toggle on a TooltipRef.

events.title: Events
events.description: onOpen and onClose fire on hover, focus, blur and Escape.

as-child.title: asChild
as-child.description: asChild attaches the tooltip to the child itself, without a wrapper element, so flex and grid layouts stay intact. contentClassName styles the tooltip.

provider.title: TooltipProvider
provider.description: A TooltipProvider sets default delays for the tooltips inside; moving quickly from one tooltip to the next opens it immediately.

TooltipProps.children: The element that triggers the tooltip; prefer a focusable element
TooltipProps.open: Whether the tooltip is shown (controlled; pair with onOpenChange)
TooltipProps.color: Semantic color of the tooltip. With the glass variant the color only tints the border (neutral keeps the plain frosted surface)
TooltipProps.variant: Visual style: solid (filled; neutral is the inverted contrasting surface), subtle (tinted surface with a border) or glass (frosted elevated surface)
TooltipProps.enterDelay: Delay before showing on hover, in milliseconds
TooltipProps.leaveDelay: Delay before hiding on mouse leave, in milliseconds
TooltipProps.offset: Offset as [x, y] in pixels. For top/bottom placements y is the gap to the trigger and x shifts along it; for left/right placements x is the gap and y shifts along it. Without it the tooltip sits 8px away
TooltipProps.followCursor: Makes the tooltip follow the mouse cursor
TooltipProps.arrow: Shows an arrow pointing at the trigger
TooltipProps.className: Additional class name of the trigger wrapper
TooltipProps.onOpen: Called when the tooltip opens from hover or focus
TooltipProps.onClose: Called when the tooltip closes from mouse leave, blur or Escape
TooltipProps.aria-label: Accessible label of the tooltip element
TooltipProps.ref: Imperative handle with open / close / toggle
TooltipProps.onOpenChange: Called with the requested open state (hover, focus, Escape, ref methods)
TooltipProps.asChild: Attaches the hover / focus handlers, the ref and className directly to the single child element instead of wrapping it in a <div> (keeps flex and grid layouts intact). The child must accept a ref
TooltipProps.contentClassName: Additional class name of the tooltip (floating) element. To customize the colors, set the --tooltip-bg (background, gradients allowed) and --tooltip-color (text) custom properties on it
TooltipProps.contentRef: Ref to the tooltip (floating) element, set while it is shown

TooltipProviderProps.enterDelay: Default delay before showing on hover, in milliseconds, for every Tooltip inside that does not set enterDelay
TooltipProviderProps.leaveDelay: Default delay before hiding on mouse leave, in milliseconds, for every Tooltip inside that does not set leaveDelay
TooltipProviderProps.skipDelay: When another tooltip of the provider closed less than this many milliseconds ago, the next one opens without waiting for its enter delay

cssVars.--tooltip-radius: Corner radius (defaults to the radius of the shape)
cssVars.--tooltip-shadow: Shadow (defaults to --shadow-md, --shadow-lg for the glass variant)
